name: Example: Custom UI Node
description: A minimal worked example of a node that renders its own React interface instead of a code editor. Filters a DataFrame's rows by a numeric threshold you pick from controls in the node body. No API keys, no Python dependencies — read it, fork it, replace the UI with your own.

templates.label: Column Filter
templates.description: Pick a numeric column, a comparison and a threshold from controls in the node body; sends the matching rows downstream. A reference implementation for custom-UI nodes.
